ammonia.reason: Surface Brevibacterium/yeast deamination and urea catabolism in smear rind.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and isovaleric acid from smear Brevibacterium proteolysis.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet and smear protease activity.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti or blue ketone pathway used.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard/lactose-protein browning in moist high-protein pasteurized curd.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from lactococcal citrate metabolism and milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and smear metabolism.

creaminess.reason: High moisture 45.9% plus 25.7% fat giving smooth smear-ripened paste.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic washed-rind protein matrix, not dry-crystalline or acid crumbly.

firmness.reason: Semi-soft 45.9% moisture rennet gel, sliceable but yielding.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from smear esterase esterification of free fatty acids.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only, no caprine 4-methyloctanoic acid signature.

melt.reason: pH 5.2 rennet curd with intact casein flows well on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Low 1-octen-3-ol from surface yeast/microbial linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: 25.7% fat semi-soft matrix releases moderate free oil when melted.

smoky.reason: No smoke application and no guaiacol formation.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic plus acetic acid from starter and surface coryneform metabolism, pH 5.2.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd, no hot-water kneading alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/dimethyl disulfide from B.linens methionine catabolism.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose, diacetyl and proline-rich peptides balancing salt 1.89%.

umami.reason: Glutamate and savory peptides from mesophilic plus smear proteolysis.
